name: Vyshaja Mast'
source:
The story of a private detective (his name is Salem Labert), who under extremely strange circumstances finds himself in the center of a brutal crime committed in his own home. Before the fatal crime, on the same day, the main character accidentally finds a suitcase with a lock, which previously belonged to his grandfather ... Are these two events connected?

[From [url=https://vss-wonderink.itch.io/the-highest-card-suit-episode-1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
讲述了一位私家侦探（他的名字叫塞勒姆·拉伯特）的故事，他在极其奇怪的情况下发现自己陷入了在自己家中犯下的残酷犯罪的中心。在致命犯罪发生之前的同一天，主角无意中发现了一个带锁的手提箱，这个手提箱以前属于他的祖父……这两件事有联系吗？

[来自[url=https://vss-wonderink.itch.io/the-highest-card-suit-episode-1]Itch.io[/url]]
